book.name: 1 KORIN
book.title: KORIN KHRISAWBU KHATEI PAUL CAKUA UIKHEHNAH

content: Khazing a rei tei Khri Zisu a apostol cang rua pawtei ypaw kama Paul le kaa unypaw Sosthen tah,

Korin khuapui letei Khazing khrisawbu, Khri Zisu letei pathaisah a cangpaw le pathai rua pawtei ypaw vytei le aa Buipaw le kaa Buipaw a cangpaw Abuipaw Zisu Khri ming a ypaw, kawting letah a ungpaw vytei khatah ca kaa cakua he.
Khazing kaa Paw le Abuipaw Zisu Khri taitei ningdonah le thlawlungnah cawh naaning khatah ung ky seh.
Lawngbia reinah
Khri Zisu thongtah, Khazing tah a ningdonah a ca pehpaw he rawng takhei Ama khaco lawngbia ka rei tei.
Ama a thongtah naaning cawh zezongpui letah chahchi na cang he ceh, naa biarei kaw-ang letah le hming naa hnithainah vytei letah zong,
zecawtamaw tatah Khri kong kaa dawkhuipaw peh khah naaning letah a pacy.
Macawtaco kaa Buipaw Zisu Khri a va lang nápaw lungsy tah naa haw thlangnah lehei thlawpaw lang lahsong a hringhrepaw a by khawh bei he ceh.
Kaa Buipaw Zisu Khri a ning letah suise naa cang ly ná pawtah Ama tah a changnah tai a ca chawngsá he a.
A Sawcapaw Zisu Khri, kaa Buipaw kha a huikongnah chunglang a ca ypaw he Khazing cawh zingchuipaw a cang.
Khrisawbu chung letei kuinah

Taico, uny sahlo pakheh le pakheh lungtlah teitah ung my lo, tatah kaa Buipaw Zisu Khri ming tah naa zongmingtei tah ka ca naw he, ma pawsui co naa hrong letah a pachainah ung be ca ka, thinglung le rawhnah letah tlangtling teitah na pakong khy he ceh.
Ka uny sahlo, naa hrong letah a hrychaenah a ung tahpaw khah Khaloi ingchungkho thaikhehpaw taitah aa pa thuisah.

Ka rei dupaw cawh ma heh a cang. Naaning naa hrong letah pakheh tah, “Kama cawh Paul a zuipaw ka cang,” tah ka, ahringpaw tah, “Kama cawh Apolo a zuipaw ka cang,” a tah, ahringpaw vy hui tah, “Kama cawh Piter a zuipaw ka cang,” tah ka, ming hringpaw taco, “Kama cawh Khri a zuipaw ka cang,” a tah.
Khri cawh a chaichy maw? Paul cawh naa cawtah khaipai a cang maw? Paul a ming letah maw baptisma cangsah naa cang?
Khripa le Kaia tah cy ly co ahohmai baptisma ka cangsah lynah caw he tah ka lawng ngetei.
Macawtaco ka ming letah baptisma ka cang tatah ahotahmai tah khy bei he.
A cang, Stefena ingchungkho khah baptisma ka cangsah hrah he. Ma khy taihei ahringpaw ka cang sahpaw he aa ung caco, a thui khawh bei neh.

Kama cawh Khri tah baptisma cang sá pawtah pa thlaw be, thawngchawbia rei rua pawtah a thlaw hripaw ka cang. Mehnung singnah bia hmang tah rei bei neh, ma hratei a cang caco, Khri thihnah khraws a hmingtuakhynah khah a longpaw tah a cang a.
Khri, Khazing singnah le hmingtuakhynah
Zecawtamaw tatah a ly leimeipaw cawngsaw sahlo caw taco khraws kong bia cawh hrunah a cang, canghrasala pachah a cang leimeipaw cawngsaw sahlo kaa caw taco Khazing hmingtuakhynah a cang.
Zecawtamaw tatah Capathai letah,

content.text: “Mehsingpaw a singnah cawh ka ro a,
mehthaipaw a thainah cawh a longpaw tah ka cangsah a,”

content: tatah ciapaw a cang.
Mehsingpaw cawh zeletamaw a ung? Phungbia a thaipaw cawh zeletamaw a ung? Atochai mehsing mehthai cawh zeletamaw aa ung? Khazaw singnah heh Khazing tah hruchuipaw tah tua thah bei maw?
Khazing singnah leco khazaw tah a singnah hmang tah Khazing khah a hni khy khawh lynah cawtah hrunah bia aa tahpaw phungreiná tah a zingpaw sahlo pachah khah Khazing a lawngpaw a cang.
Juda cawngsaw sahlo taco ningang chuipaw paching pakhanah khah hmuh du he ka, Grik cawngsaw sahlo taco singnah khah aa hui,
canghrasala kaaning cawh Juda cawngsaw sahlo a pachihlynah a cangpaw le Gental cawngsaw sahlo hrunah a cangpaw, Khri aa khaipainah kong kaa rei.
Canghrasala, Khazing tei a ypaw, Juda cawngsaw sahlo le Grik cawngsaw sahlo aa caw taco Khri cawh Khazing hmingtuakhynah le Khazing singnah a cang.
Zecawtamaw tatah Khazing hrunah cawh mehnung singnah navy tah sing vy ka, Khazing sangtlelynah cawh mehnung chongnah navy tah a chong vy.
Uny sahlo, y naa za cang ning takhei zehapaw cawngsaw maw naa cang tahpaw khah rawh tua o. Cawngsaw mehmuh letah mehsing tahpaw le huhang a hnuipaw le mehlai mehsui tahpaw ahlupui ung bei he ceh.

Canghrasala, Khazing taco a singpaw ningzaw sá pawtah khazaw tah hrunah aa tahpaw hming sahlo khah a thing he, a thawchongpaw ningzaw sá pawtah khazaw tei sangtle lypaw aa tahpaw hming sahlo khah a thing he.

Khazing taco khazaw tei biapui tah a rawhpaw hming sahlo cawh zehmai cang bei he tahnah takhei khazaw letei a nai caipaw le zetah sah lypaw hming sahlo, biapui tei rawh lypaw hming sahlo khah a thing he.
Macawtaco Khazing hme letah ahohmai a pachaw khy bei he.
Ma Khazing thong hei, kaa cawtah Khazing singnah a cangpaw Khri Zisu letah naa ungpaw a cang, ma cawh kaa dingnah, pathainah le tlangnah a cang.
Macawtaco Capathai letei ciapaw hratah, “A pachawpaw maikaw taco, Abuipaw khah a pachaw he seh.” tatah cia a cang.
